selection_rule: Select the first two fixed_case_order IDs without status=completed. Do not mark blocked or partial reviews completed.

findings.finding: The rejected mathematical-medicine direction was not fully assessed against available medical-imaging and quantitative-pharmacology content. Its rationale effectively required a dedicated named mathematical-medicine sequence, which the related-fields contract does not require.
findings.correction: Include a third complete Mathematics, computation & biomedical modelling alternative, with seven biomedical foundations/application courses, explicit contribution/limitation traces, a six-semester schedule and pairwise distinctness checks. Change the candidate outcome and stopping decision to ucr-3 and maximum-reached.

findings.finding: The image-processing trace named convolution, which is not explicit in that course workbook profile.
findings.correction: Use the documented image representations, local/edge filters, feature detection and segmentation. Explicit medical imaging supplies the third-alternative link; no specialist clinical-imaging claim is made.

findings.finding: The no-match remains academically justified. UCR has discrete contributions in myth, religious visual culture, ancient religious identity, philosophy, natural law, conflict and belief-related social inquiry, but too few courses with religion as their substantive object to sustain 23 non-PPD courses in a coherent religion-centred programme.
